qe: Who presided over the Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress in December 1929 that passed the 'Purna Swaraj' resolution?
qh: दिसंबर 1929 के भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के लाहौर अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी जिसमें 'पूर्ण स्वराज' का प्रस्ताव पारित हुआ?
e: Under Jawaharlal Nehru's presidency at Lahore (1929), Purna Swaraj was declared and 26 Jan 1930 was celebrated as Independence Day.

qe: Which Constitutional Article provides for a 'Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India'?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद 'भारत के नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक (CAG)' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: Article 148 provides for the CAG (guardian of the public purse); Art 124 = Supreme Court; Art 280 = Finance Commission; Art 324 = ECI.

qe: In which year was the 'Nalanda Mahavihara' declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
qh: 'नालंदा महाविहार' को किस वर्ष UNESCO विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित किया गया था?
e: Mahabodhi Temple (Bodh Gaya) was listed in 2002, and Archaeological Site of Nalanda Mahavihara was inscribed in July 2016.

qe: Which port on India's west coast is a tidal port located in the Gulf of Kutch, Gujarat (renamed Deendayal Port)?
qh: भारत के पश्चिमी तट पर गुजरात के कच्छ की खाड़ी में स्थित कौन-सा ज्वारीय बंदरगाह (Tidal Port) है जिसका नाम दीनदयाल बंदरगाह रखा गया है?
e: Kandla Port (Deendayal Port Authority) in Gujarat is a major tidal port on India's western coast.

qe: Who was the first Chief Election Commissioner of India?
qh: भारत के प्रथम मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त (Chief Election Commissioner) कौन थे?
e: Sukumar Sen served as India's first Chief Election Commissioner (1950–1958), overseeing the 1951–52 and 1957 general elections.

qe: Which Gupta Emperor took the title 'Vikramaditya' and had the 'Navratnas' including Kalidasa in his court?
qh: किस गुप्त सम्राट ने 'विक्रमादित्य' की उपाधि धारण की थी और उनके दरबार में कालिदास सहित 'नवरत्न' थे?
e: Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya) presided over the golden age of Gupta art, literature, and science.

qe: What is the 'Kaziranga National Park' in Assam famous for conserving?
qh: असम का 'काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान' किस जीव के संरक्षण के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Kaziranga (a UNESCO site in Assam) hosts the world's largest population of Great One-horned Rhinoceroses.

qe: Which Five-Year Plan or economic reform year marked the introduction of LPG (Liberalization, Privatization, Globalization) in India?
qh: भारत में उदारीकरण, निजीकरण और वैश्वीकरण (LPG) आर्थिक सुधार किस वर्ष लागू किए गए थे?
e: The New Economic Policy (LPG reforms) was launched in July 1991 under PM P.V. Narasimha Rao and Finance Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh.

qe: Who was the author of 'Indica', an account of Mauryan India and Pataliputra?
qh: मौर्यकालीन भारत और पाटलिपुत्र का वर्णन करने वाली पुस्तक 'इंडिका' (Indica) के लेखक कौन थे?
e: Megasthenes was the Greek ambassador sent by Seleucus I Nicator to the court of Chandragupta Maurya.

qe: Which state in India is known as the 'Spice Garden of India'?
qh: भारत का कौन-सा राज्य 'भारत का मसाला उद्यान' (Spice Garden of India) कहलाता है?
e: Kerala is renowned for black pepper, cardamom, clove, cinnamon, and nutmeg cultivation.

qe: How many languages are currently listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India?
qh: वर्तमान में भारतीय संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची (Eighth Schedule) में कुल कितनी भाषाएँ शामिल हैं?
e: Originally 14, the 8th Schedule now lists 22 languages (including Maithili from Bihar, added via the 92nd Amendment Act 2003).

qe: Which classical musical instrument is Ustad Bismillah Khan (Bharat Ratna, born in Dumraon, Bihar) legendary for playing?
qh: डुमराँव (बिहार) में जन्मे भारत रत्न उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह खाँ किस शास्त्रीय वाद्ययंत्र के महान वादक थे?
e: Ustad Bismillah Khan popularized the Shehnai on global concert stages and played at Red Fort on 15 August 1947.

qe: What does 'NABARD' stand for?
qh: 'नाबार्ड' (NABARD) का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
oe: National Authority for Banking and Retail Debt
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
New Agricultural Bureau for Rural Districts
National Board for Aviation and Road Development
oh: National Authority for Banking and Retail Debt
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
New Agricultural Bureau for Rural Districts
National Board for Aviation and Road Development
e: Established on 12 July 1982 on Shivraman Committee's recommendation, NABARD is India's apex rural credit institution.

qe: Who was the first Indian recipient of the Nobel Prize (1913, in Literature for 'Gitanjali')?
qh: नोबेल पुरस्कार प्राप्त करने वाले प्रथम भारतीय (1913 में 'गीतांजलि' के लिए साहित्य में) कौन थे?
e: Rabindranath Tagore won the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature; C.V. Raman won Physics in 1930.

qe: Which Constitutional Amendment introduced the Tenth Schedule (Anti-Defection Law) in 1985?
qh: 1985 में किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा दसवीं अनुसूची (दल-बदल विरोधी कानून) को संविधान में जोड़ा गया?
e: The 52nd Amendment Act (1985) added the Tenth Schedule to curb political defections.

qe: Which subatomic particle carries a negative electric charge?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस उप-परमाण्विक कण पर ऋणात्मक (Negative) विद्युत आवेश होता है?
e: Electrons have −1 elementary charge; Protons have +1; Neutrons are electrically neutral.

qe: What is the SI unit of pressure?
qh: दाब (Pressure) की SI इकाई क्या है?
e: Pressure P = Force / Area is measured in Pascals (1 Pa = 1 N/m²).

qe: Which part of a flowering plant develops into a fruit after fertilization?
qh: पुष्पीय पौधों में निषेचन के बाद फूल का कौन-सा भाग फल (Fruit) में विकसित होता है?
e: After fertilization, the ovary ripens into the fruit and ovules develop into seeds.

qe: What is 'Dry Ice'?
qh: 'शुष्क बर्फ' (Dry Ice) क्या होती है?
e: Solid CO₂ sublimates directly from solid to gas at −78.5°C without leaving liquid residue.

qe: Which vitamin deficiency causes 'Night Blindness' (Xerophthalmia)?
qh: किस विटामिन की कमी से 'रतौंधी' (Night Blindness) रोग होता है?
e: Vitamin A is needed to produce rhodopsin pigment in retinal rod cells.

qe: Which metal is extracted from Bauxite ore?
qh: बॉक्साइट (Bauxite) अयस्क से किस धातु का निष्कर्षण किया जाता है?
e: Bauxite (Al₂O₃·2H₂O) is the primary ore of Aluminium; Haematite is iron ore.

qe: What is the normal pH range of human blood?
qh: मानव रक्त का सामान्य pH मान कितना होता है?
e: Human arterial blood is tightly buffered around pH 7.35–7.45.

qe: Which phenomenon explains why a pencil partly dipped in water appears bent at the surface?
qh: पानी में आंशिक रूप से डूबी हुई पेंसिल सतह पर मुड़ी हुई क्यों दिखाई देती है?
e: Light rays bend as they pass from optically denser water into rarer air.

qe: Which gas is primarily responsible for the 'Bhopal Gas Tragedy' of 1984?
qh: 1984 की 'भोपाल गैस त्रासदी' के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन-सी जहरीली गैस उत्तरदायी थी?
e: Leakage of Methyl Isocyanate (CH₃NCO) from the Union Carbide pesticide plant caused the 1984 tragedy.

qe: Which organ in the human body produces 'Bile juice' (stored in the gallbladder)?
qh: मानव शरीर का कौन-सा अंग 'पित्त रस' (Bile juice) का निर्माण करता है (जो पित्ताशय में जमा होता है)?
e: The liver produces bile (which emulsifies fats in the duodenum) and stores it in the gallbladder.

qe: What is the escape velocity from Earth's surface (approximately)?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह से पलायन वेग (Escape Velocity) लगभग कितना होता है?
e: Escape velocity vₑ = √(2gR) ≈ 11.2 km/s for Earth.

qe: Which isotope of Carbon is used in radiocarbon dating of ancient fossils and archaeological samples?
qh: प्राचीन जीवाश्मों और पुरातत्व नमूनों की आयु ज्ञात करने के लिए कार्बन के किस समस्थानिक (Isotope) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Radioactive C-14 (half-life ~5,730 years) is used in radiocarbon dating.

qe: Which device converts mechanical energy into electrical energy?
qh: कौन-सा यंत्र यांत्रिक ऊर्जा को विद्युत ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित करता है?
e: A generator/dynamo converts mechanical rotation into electrical energy via electromagnetic induction; a motor does the reverse.

qe: Which acid is injected by an ant sting, causing burning irritation?
qh: चींटी के डंक में कौन-सा अम्ल होता है जिससे जलन महसूस होती है?
e: Ants and nettle stings inject methanoic/formic acid (HCOOH); mild base like baking soda neutralizes it.

qe: Which type of asexual reproduction occurs in Amoeba during favourable conditions?
qh: अनुकूल परिस्थितियों में अमीबा (Amoeba) में किस प्रकार का अलैंगिक प्रजनन होता है?
e: Amoeba divides into two identical daughter cells via binary fission (Yeast uses budding).
